items.definition:
a blemish or flaw
The scratch was a mar on the otherwise perfect surface.

a record of events year by year
The annal recorded the major events of the kingdom.

Intense happiness; the ability to find appropriate expression for one's thoughts.
She expressed her thoughts with great felicity.

The study and treatment of tumors
She decided to specialize in oncology.

a particle representing a quantum of light or other electromagnetic radiation
Light is composed of tiny particles called photons.

a Turkish title of respect or honor
The bey ruled over the province for many years.

A compound consisting of two or more amino acids linked in a chain.
Peptides play a crucial role in biological processes.

a chronic disease involving hardening of body tissue
Multiple sclerosis affects the brain and spinal cord.

a measure of the disorder or randomness of a system
The universe tends towards increasing entropy.

cancer of the lymphatic system
He was diagnosed with lymphoma last year.

the devising or choosing of names for things, especially in a science or other discipline
The scientific nomenclature for plants can be complex.

Messenger ribonucleic acid, a type of RNA that carries genetic information from DNA to the ribosome.
mRNA vaccines use messenger RNA to teach our cells how to make a protein.

a branch of mathematics
Topology is a complex field of mathematics.

the thickening and scarring of connective tissue
Pulmonary fibrosis affects the lungs.

a circular opening, especially at the apex of a dome
The Pantheon in Rome is famous for its large oculus.

resistance to an alternating current
The engineer measured the electrical impedance of the circuit.

each of two or more forms of the same element
Carbon-14 is a radioactive isotope used in dating ancient artifacts.

The theory or philosophy of law
She specialized in comparative jurisprudence during her law studies.

leadership or dominance, especially by one state or social group over others
The country sought to establish its hegemony over the region.

A unit of phonological weight or a genus of trees
In phonology, a long vowel can be considered to have two moras.

an expression of more than two algebraic terms
We learned how to factor a quadratic polynomial in math class.

sexual attraction to children
Pedophilia is a serious crime.

An organelle found in large numbers in most cells, in which the biochemical processes of respiration and energy production occur.
The mitochondrion is often called the powerhouse of the cell.

a localized, blood-filled balloon-like bulge in the wall of a blood vessel
He suffered a brain aneurysm.

the district or see of an archbishop
The archdiocese covers several counties.

a substance formed in or necessary for metabolism
Researchers are studying the various metabolites produced by the bacteria.

the protection, backing, or support of a particular person or organization
The project was launched under the aegis of the United Nations.

a positively charged ion (NH4+)
Ammonium compounds are often used in fertilizers.

A descendant of a notable family.
He was a scion of a wealthy banking family.

a mathematical object
In physics, a tensor is a geometric object that describes linear relations between geometric vectors, scalars, and other tensors.

imaging by sections
CT scans use X-ray tomography to create detailed images of the body.

a ghost or ghostlike image of someone
He saw a pale wraith disappear into the mist.

belief in the abolition of all government
Anarchism advocates for a society without rulers.

a statement or proposition which is regarded as being established, accepted, or self-evidently true
It is an axiom that a straight line is the shortest distance between two points.

a group of eye conditions
Glaucoma can lead to blindness if not treated.

Regular payment made into a fund by an employee toward a future pension
Employees contribute to their superannuation fund each month.

a compound consisting of a nucleoside linked to a phosphate group
DNA is made up of long chains of nucleotides.

the branch of molecular biology concerned with the structure, function, evolution, and mapping of genomes
Advances in genomics are revolutionizing personalized medicine.

a lout or hooligan, especially one who drives recklessly (Australian/NZ slang)
The police issued a warning to the hoons doing burnouts in the car park.

common sense; practical intelligence
He showed considerable nous in handling the difficult situation.

a tract of grassland; a ley line
Ancient monuments are often said to be built along ley lines.

a turn or change, especially in poetry or music
The volta in the sonnet marked a shift in tone.

the process of gradually writing off the initial cost of an asset
The loan's amortization schedule showed the principal and interest payments over time.

a powerful, highly addictive stimulant drug
The police seized a large quantity of methamphetamine.

lack of power or ability to act
The government's impotence in the face of the crisis was evident.

the fact of two things being seen or placed close together with contrasting effect
The artist used juxtaposition to highlight the differences.

An enzyme that synthesizes long chains of polymers.
DNA polymerase plays a crucial role in DNA replication.

the measurement of spectra
Mass spectrometry is used to identify unknown compounds.

a laboratory technique for the separation of a mixture
Chromatography is used to separate pigments in plants.

a condition characterized by an excess of watery fluid accumulating in the body
The doctor diagnosed the patient with edema in their legs.

Disinterested and selfless concern for the well-being of others.
His act of altruism saved many lives.

the abandonment or renunciation of a religious or political belief
His public declaration of atheism was seen by some as an act of apostasy.

the death of most or all of the cells in an organ or tissue due to disease, injury, or failure of the blood supply
The doctor explained that the tissue damage was due to necrosis.

A chemical element
Selenium is an essential trace element for humans.

A compound of sulfur with another element or group
Hydrogen sulfide is a toxic gas.

A taxonomic group of any rank, such as a species, family, or class
Humans belong to the taxon Homo sapiens.

one of two or more alternative forms of a gene
Each parent contributes one allele for every gene.

a compound containing the hydroxide ion
Sodium hydroxide is a strong base used in many industrial processes.

a magician or sorcerer
The ancient text described a powerful magus who could control the elements.

the addition of a methyl group to a substrate
DNA methylation plays a crucial role in gene expression.

a chief magistrate of a town or district
The reeve was responsible for maintaining order in the village.

the process by which molecules adhere to a surface
The experiment studied the adsorption of gases on metal surfaces.

the theory of knowledge, especially with regard to its methods, validity, and scope
His research focuses on the epistemology of science.

a glottal stop in Arabic
The hamza is an important phoneme in Arabic pronunciation.

the state of being or going beyond the limits of ordinary experience
Many spiritual traditions seek to achieve a state of transcendence.

a man who held land by military service, ranking between an ordinary freeman and a hereditary noble
Macbeth was the Thane of Cawdor.

a plant, especially a herbaceous one; the liquid extracted from the malt in the brewing process
The brewer added hops to the wort before fermentation.

A waxy, translucent, starch-like protein that is deposited in tissues in certain diseases.
Abnormal amyloid deposits are a hallmark of Alzheimer's disease.

the genetic constitution of an individual organism
The genotype determines the observable characteristics of an organism.

a type of alcohol, often used as antifreeze
Ethylene glycol is a common ingredient in antifreeze.

cruel and bitter criticism
The politician's speech was full of vitriol against his opponents.

a Scottish town or borough
Edinburgh is a historic burgh with a rich past.

the chemical breakdown of a compound due to reaction with water
The enzyme catalyzes the hydrolysis of starch.

a nonessential amino acid
Tyrosine is an important amino acid in the human body.

the action of inserting something of a different nature into something else
The data analysis involved interpolation to estimate missing values.

The tube that carries urine from the bladder.
The doctor explained the function of the urethra.

A soft, gentle breeze.
A gentle zephyr rustled the leaves.

the obstruction of the blood supply to an organ or region of tissue, causing local tissue death
A myocardial infarction is commonly known as a heart attack.

a former French coin of small value; a small amount of money
He didn't have a sou to his name after losing everything.

a device that converts energy from one form to another
The microphone acts as a transducer, converting sound waves into electrical signals.

a kiss
He gave his child a loving buss on the forehead.

a foolish or incompetent person (offensive slang)
Don't be such a dipshit and pay attention!

a type of white blood cell that is part of the immune system
Lymphocytes play a crucial role in the body's defense against disease.

a disease or dysfunction of one or more peripheral nerves
Diabetic neuropathy can cause numbness and pain in the feet.

a chemical substance that transmits nerve impulses across a synapse
Serotonin is an important neurotransmitter that affects mood.

The science of collecting and analyzing complex biological data.
Bioinformatics plays a crucial role in modern genetic research.

a comprehensive treatise or summary
He wrote a summa of his philosophical ideas.

The manner of development of a disease
Understanding the pathogenesis of the virus is crucial for developing effective treatments.

A radioactive isotope of carbon, especially carbon-14
Scientists use radiocarbon dating to determine the age of ancient artifacts.

a piece of armor for the shin
The knight wore greaves to protect his legs.

the abnormal narrowing of a passage in the body
Spinal stenosis can cause pain and numbness.

something or someone that one vehemently dislikes; a formal curse
The idea of war was anathema to him.

positively charged ion
A cation is an ion with a net positive charge.

complex of DNA and proteins in cells
Chromatin condenses to form chromosomes during cell division.

a protein that acts as a messenger between cells
Cytokines play a crucial role in the immune response.

neoliberalism (a political approach that favors free-market capitalism)
Critics argue that neoliberalism has led to increased economic inequality.

oeuvre (the complete work of an artist, composer, or writer)
The exhibition showcased the entire oeuvre of the renowned painter.

ordinator (one who ordains or coordinates; often in a religious or technical context)
The ordinator was responsible for overseeing the complex project schedule.

the surgical removal of part of an organ or structure
The patient underwent a bowel resection.

a disease of the arteries characterized by the deposition of fatty material on their inner walls
Atherosclerosis can lead to heart attacks and strokes.

the removal of the testicles
Veterinarians often perform castration on male animals.

a fatal epidemic disease.
The city was ravaged by a terrible pestilence.

a space or chamber in which air or other gas is at a pressure greater than that of the outside atmosphere; also, a meeting attended by all members of a committee or conference.
The air conditioning system uses a plenum to distribute air.

a male sex hormone
Androgen levels can affect various bodily functions in men.

the defining spirit or mood of a particular period of history as shown by the ideas and beliefs of the time.
The film perfectly captured the zeitgeist of the 1960s.

the act or process of adjudicating a dispute.
The dispute is currently awaiting adjudication.

a type of subatomic particle
The Higgs boson is sometimes called the 'God particle'.

a defensive wall or protection
The old castle walls served as a bulwark against invaders.

the branch of physiology and medicine concerned with endocrine glands and hormones
She decided to specialize in endocrinology.

the quality or state of being diverse in character or content
The study examined the heterogeneity of the patient population.

Treatment that uses the body's immune system
Immunotherapy is a promising new cancer treatment.

The action of intervening on behalf of another
He sought divine intercession for his ailing mother.

A protein that inhibits virus replication
Interferon is used in the treatment of some viral infections.

a set of beliefs or assumptions about something
The film explores the mythos surrounding the ancient hero.

the purity or intensity of color
The artist adjusted the chroma to make the colors more vibrant.

a dull, heavy sound, especially of an explosion
They heard the distant crump of artillery.

a coefficient or constant that expresses a particular property of a substance or system
In physics, the Young's modulus measures the stiffness of a material.

a malignant tumor of the bone marrow
Multiple myeloma is a type of cancer.

blockage; the meeting of teeth
The dental occlusion was perfect after the braces.

a friend (often used in legal contexts, e.g., amicus curiae)
The court allowed an amicus brief to be filed by the non-profit organization.

any of a group of compounds consisting of a hemoprotein and functioning as electron transfer agents in metabolic pathways
Cytochrome P450 enzymes play a crucial role in drug metabolism.

a chemical element (Mo)
Molybdenum is a silvery-white metal used in alloys.

a major estrogen hormone
Estradiol plays a key role in the female reproductive system and bone health.

a contrapuntal musical composition or a state of amnesia
The composer's latest work included a complex fugue.

philosophical study of experience and consciousness
His research focused on the phenomenology of perception.

the study of language in historical context
She pursued a degree in classical philology.

a condition in which tissue similar to the lining of the uterus grows outside the uterus
Endometriosis can cause severe pelvic pain.

similarity in structure or function due to common ancestry
The homology between human and ape skeletons is striking.

the enlargement of an organ or tissue from the increase in size of its cells
Weightlifting can lead to muscle hypertrophy.

immoral or grossly unfair behavior
The judge spoke out against the iniquity of the system.

the condition of occurring in several different forms
In biology, polymorphism refers to the existence of multiple forms within a species.

a malignant tumor of connective or other nonepithelial tissue
The doctor diagnosed the patient with a rare form of sarcoma.

the act or process of moving something from one place to another
The translocation of the endangered species was carefully planned.

intellectuals or highly educated people
The city's intelligentsia gathered for the literary discussion.

the acceleration of a chemical reaction by a catalyst
Enzyme catalysis is crucial for many biological processes.

the art of investigating or discussing the truth of opinions
Plato's dialogues are a classic example of the dialectic method.

a powerful antioxidant found in plants, animals, fungi, and some bacteria and archaea
Glutathione plays a crucial role in protecting cells from damage.

a type of cytokine produced by white blood cells
Interleukin-6 plays a role in the body's immune response.

a small room or monument, cut in rock or built of stone, in which a dead person is laid or buried
The ancient king was laid to rest in a grand sepulchre.

a fortified camp of Ukrainian Cossacks
The Zaporozhian Sich was a semi-independent Cossack polity.

Any of a group of steroid hormones produced in the adrenal cortex or made synthetically.
The doctor prescribed a corticosteroid to reduce the inflammation.

The abnormal growth or development of cells, tissue, or organs.
The biopsy revealed signs of dysplasia.

Any disease of the brain that alters brain function or structure.
The patient was diagnosed with hepatic encephalopathy.

critical explanation or interpretation of a text, especially of scripture
His exegesis of the ancient text provided new insights.

a common mineral, lead sulfide, that is the principal ore of lead
Galena has a distinctive metallic luster.

a collection of preserved plant specimens, typically dried and mounted on sheets, with associated data, used for scientific study
The botanist spent hours in the herbarium.

a region of the forebrain below the thalamus that coordinates the autonomic nervous system and the activity of the pituitary, controlling body temperature, thirst, hunger, and other homeostatic systems, and involved in sleep and emotional activity
The hypothalamus plays a crucial role in regulating body temperature.

A salt in which the anion contains silicon and oxygen.
Quartz is a common silicate mineral.

a disease of the heart muscle
His diagnosis was dilated cardiomyopathy.

a sulfur-containing amino acid
Cysteine is one of the 20 standard amino acids.

the seminal fluid of male fish
The male salmon releases milt during spawning.

a wise and skillful lawgiver; a member of a legislative body
The ancient Greek solon introduced many reforms.

the state or process of being deprived of oxygen, which can result in unconsciousness or death
The cause of death was determined to be asphyxiation.

a class of psychoactive drugs
The doctor prescribed a benzodiazepine to help with anxiety.

machine (Latin, often in 'deus ex machina')
The sudden appearance of the hero felt like a deus ex machina.

a New Zealand tree or shrub of the myrtle family
The rata tree was covered in vibrant red flowers.

a male roe deer
A roebuck was spotted grazing in the field.

a type of traditional Okinawan weapon, or (archaic) a groom or attendant
The martial artist wielded two sais with precision.

a dry, winged fruit containing a single seed
Maple trees produce samara seeds that spin as they fall.

a woman who takes a dominant role in sadomasochistic sexual activity
The film explored the complex character of a dominatrix.

the action by the state or an authority of taking property from its owner for public use or benefit
The government announced the expropriation of land for the new highway.

a feudal tenant's or vassal's fidelity to a lord
The knights swore fealty to their king.

a cell in connective tissue that produces collagen and other fibers
Fibroblasts play a crucial role in wound healing.

the action of degrading someone to the status of a mere object
The essay discussed the objectification of women in media.

carbolic acid
Phenol is used in the production of plastics and disinfectants.

strong verbal or written attack
His essay was a fierce polemic against modern art.

antiparticle of the electron
A positron has the same mass as an electron but a positive charge.

an omen or sign
The sudden drop in temperature was a prognostic of a harsh winter.

a group of five
The quint of musicians performed a classical piece.

A person, especially an ambassador, invested with full power to transact business.
The plenipotentiary was authorized to sign the treaty.

cell division
Mitosis is a fundamental process for life, where a single cell divides into two identical daughter cells.

the practice of re-examining and reinterpreting historical events
The historian was accused of revisionism for his controversial new theory.

a drug used to treat retroviral infections, such as HIV
Antiretroviral drugs have significantly improved the lives of HIV patients.

a simple amino acid
Glycine is one of the simplest amino acids.

the study of the nervous system
She is pursuing a degree in neurobiology.

a compound of nitrogen with a more electropositive element
Silicon nitride is a ceramic material used in high-temperature applications.

a hormone and neurotransmitter
Norepinephrine plays a role in the body's 'fight or flight' response.

a structure that guides waves
Fiber optics use a type of waveguide to transmit light signals.

a neurotransmitter
Acetylcholine plays a key role in muscle contraction.

loss of ability to understand or express speech
After the stroke, he suffered from aphasia, making communication difficult.

a small rounded mass of a substance, especially of chewed food
The patient received a bolus of medication intravenously.

a fluid-filled sac that functions as a cushion between bones, tendons, and muscles
Inflammation of the bursa can cause pain in the shoulder.

the scientific study of the structure and properties of crystals
X-ray crystallography is crucial for determining molecular structures.

an abnormal connection between two body parts
The patient developed a fistula after the surgery.

the complete flower head of a plant including stems, stalks, bracts, and flowers
The sunflower has a large inflorescence.

an enzyme that removes phosphate groups
Alkaline phosphatase levels are often measured in blood tests.

a chain of amino acids linked by peptide bonds
Proteins are large polypeptides folded into specific three-dimensional structures.

a colorless gaseous hydrocarbon
Polypropylene is a plastic made from propylene monomers.

an administrative governor or guardian in some Muslim countries
The wali was responsible for the province's administration.

a modern pagan religion with roots in pre-Christian traditions
She is studying the history and practices of Wicca.

the proportion of the incident light or radiation that is reflected by a surface
The albedo of snow is very high, reflecting most sunlight.

the science of communications and automatic control systems in both machines and living things
Cybernetics explores the principles of control and communication in complex systems.

a philosophical theory emphasizing individual existence, freedom, and responsibility
Jean-Paul Sartre was a key figure in existentialism.

a portion or part of something
Each partner received an equal moiety of the profits.

a strong opioid pain medication
Oxycodone is a powerful painkiller often prescribed for severe pain.

action taken to prevent disease
Dental prophylaxis is important for maintaining good oral health.

combination of multiple states
Quantum superposition is a fundamental principle of quantum mechanics.

abnormally rapid heart rate
The patient was diagnosed with supraventricular tachycardia.

a protein found in blood plasma and egg white
Albumin is a key protein for maintaining osmotic pressure in blood.

a salary, fee, or profit from employment or office
The CEO's emoluments included a large bonus and stock options.

Any of a class of chemical compounds that act on cannabinoid receptors in cells.
Researchers are studying the potential therapeutic effects of various cannabinoids.

An extensive fire that destroys a great deal of land or property.
The city was devastated by a massive conflagration that lasted for days.

spirit or ghost; the intellectual, moral, and cultural climate of an era
The novel perfectly captured the zeitgeist of the 1960s.

any of a class of proteins that have carbohydrate groups attached to the polypeptide chain
Glycoproteins play a crucial role in cell recognition.

the action of making something obscure, unclear, or unintelligible
The politician's speech was full of obfuscation, avoiding direct answers.

the action of making or declaring something holy; the process of becoming holy
The process of sanctification is central to many religious beliefs and practices.

a hard, silvery-grey metallic element
Vanadium is used to make strong steel alloys.

a segment of a DNA or RNA molecule containing information coding for a protein or peptide sequence
Genes are composed of introns and exons.
